detail: RIG preset (pJoy Pro, Saitek X52, two Twin Sticks, vJoy 1+2), unplug/replug, test_j13_multi_device (7, ~9 s). It found the vJoy Viewer device list ignoring renames; fixed (PAIR-NAMES). Full run time after: journeys 58 s, unit parts ~5 min (one part 7 min under load).
title: Tests use one stick and one vJoy by default: add a multi-device rig and journey
